graph: bidirectional encoder (BERT / RoBERTa / DeBERTa / ModernBERT ...) + task head

head: architectures[0] suffix (MaskedLM / TokenClassification / SequenceClassification), num_labels, id2label
<arch>.pooling_type

dims_format: symbol -> [safetensors config.json expression, GGUF KV expression]; <arch> = general.architecture; B, T, q, k are example sizes picked by the builder

files: *.safetensors header: 8-byte LE length + JSON {name: {dtype, shape, data_offsets}, __metadata__}
safetensors.quantization: config.json quantization_config {quant_method, weight_block_size, fmt}; scale tensors *_scale_inv / *.scales

files: *.gguf header: magic, version, tensor_count, kv_count, KV metadata, tensor infos
tensor_fields: name (llama.cpp scheme: token_embd, blk.N.attn_q, blk.N.ffn_gate_exps, output, output_norm) -> tensors[].checkpoint_key, kept as-is (see json/mixtral-8x7b-instruct-q4km.json)
gguf.split_files: multi-part *-00001-of-0000N.gguf: tensors spread across parts; KV in part 1

graph_json: tensormorph-viz-graph v1 (json/*.json): model.name, dims, axes, aliases, tensors[] (checkpoint_key, shape, dtype), ops[], edges[], groups, multiplications, totals
